expected_answer:

Jenny Answer: Best resources:
https://github.com/bdaiinstitute/ros_utilities/wiki/Process-wide-APIs and https://github.com/bdaiinstitute/ros_utilities/tree/main/synchros2/examples
uses_tf: When true, access TF listener with import synchros2.scope as ros_scope; tf_listener = ros_scope.tf_listener() 
prebaked: Yes it automatically uses the auto scaling executor.  You get the node with ros_scope.node().  You can set the name with prebaked=<custom_name>
autospin: The node is automatically spinning in the background but the main process does not block.  If prebaked is true then autospin is also true
